annotations.title: Test a policy on my project

description: Runs example messages against one of the user's Advanced mode projects, with a draft policy or the saved one, and says which would be flagged, with a score and reason for each. Mark each example with expect "flag" or "pass" and the summary counts how many came back as expected. The project's word rules run first, as they do live. Nothing is stored and no credits are used. Up to 50 examples per call.

expect.description: What the policy should do with it.

policy.description: Draft policy in plain English, up to 1,000 characters. Leave out to test the saved policy.

threshold.description: Flag above this score, 0 to 1. Leave out to use the project's setting.

name: test_policy_on_project
